review: Large visible crown, shoulder tops and foreshortened body restore the selected overhead camera.
Gray hair, gray-green jacket and compact brown medical case distinguish Ren from Ada.
Source has white RGB background; authorized neutral-matte-unmix-1 produces genuine alpha without resizing or repainting the subject.
Foot aligned to 320,600 in 640-square cell; uniform scale 0.08 gives approximately 33 world units of visible height.
Painted detail is simpler than the reference. Accepted only as a local standing representation; not a full four-direction walking atlas or proof of batch generation quality.
scope: New preflight journeys explicitly bind ren-standing-v1. Existing saves without standingCast retain development markers. Original story production gate remains closed.
